𝗛𝗶𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 — 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲𝘀 𝗮𝘁 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗲𝘅𝗰𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗔𝗜 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗲𝘀 𝗜'𝗺 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 

I'm partnering with a well-funded, AI-native product company building conversational AI agents that large enterprises deploy in production across multiple markets. Founders with prior exits, real traction, and scaling fast. These are the seats I'm prioritising right now:

🔧 𝗙𝗼𝗿𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗱 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗹𝗼𝘆𝗲𝗱 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝘀 — 𝘁𝗼𝗽 𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘁𝘆 (𝟲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲𝘀)
Engineer-first, client-embedded: you customise and deploy the platform into enterprise environments, build the integrations, and own getting clients live. Strong hands-on engineering (Python) + genuine client-facing ownership.

3 × Spanish market — bilingual English/Spanish
1 × French speaker · 1 × German/DACH speaker · 1 × Italian speaker
Based in Spain (Barcelona/Madrid, hybrid).

📈 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗹𝗼𝘆𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗶𝘀𝘁𝘀 — 𝘁𝗼𝗽 𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘁𝘆 (𝟯 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲𝘀)
Own enterprise rollout, adoption and value realisation — turning signed accounts into live, expanding ones.

Ex-McKinsey / Bain / BCG consultants with real technical acumen (not analyst-level)
Comfortable with travel to the USA
The rare strategy-meets-technical profile who can sit with a client's leadership and their engineers.

🤖 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 / 𝗔𝗜 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲𝘀 — 𝗼𝗻𝗴𝗼𝗶𝗻𝗴
Still actively hiring across the engineering side: Agentic AI Engineers (production multi-agent systems, orchestration, memory, tool-calling, eval), plus Engineering and Technical Leads — hands-on builders who ship. Barcelona/Madrid hybrid; competitive comp + equity.

If this sounds like you — or someone you rate — DM me or drop a comment. Happy to share more. 👇

#Hiring #AI #ForwardDeployed #AgenticAI #TechJobs #Consulting #Barcelona #Madrid

𝗪𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗰𝗿𝗼𝘀𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗯𝗼𝗮𝗿𝗱 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗲𝘅𝗰𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗔𝗜 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗲𝘀 𝗜'𝘃𝗲 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗲𝗱 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵

I'm partnering with a well-funded, AI-first product company building conversational AI agents that large enterprises actually deploy in production, across multiple markets. 

The short version of why it's worth your attention:

🚀 𝗕𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗲𝗱 𝗯𝘆 𝘁𝗼𝗽-𝘁𝗶𝗲𝗿 𝗶𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗹 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗽𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 
👥 𝗙𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗺𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗼𝗿 𝗲𝘅𝗶𝘁𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝗼'𝘃𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘀𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗲𝗱 𝗯𝗲𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗲
📈 𝗠𝗲𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴𝗳𝘂𝗹 𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝗵𝗶𝗿𝗲 (𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻 𝗮 𝗽𝗶𝗲𝗰𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘄𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱)
💶 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝘁𝗶𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽 𝗯𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗵𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘁𝗼𝗽 𝟭%
🌍 𝗙𝗹𝗲𝘅𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗵𝘆𝗯𝗿𝗶𝗱 𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗕𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗻𝗮 𝗼𝗿 𝗠𝗮𝗱𝗿𝗶𝗱 
⚡ 𝗔 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵-𝗼𝘄𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽, 𝗳𝗮𝘀𝘁-𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽𝗽𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗰𝘂𝗹𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 

The roles (Barcelona / Madrid):

🤖 𝗔𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗔𝗜 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿 𝘅𝟱 - Build production LLM agents end-to-end: orchestration, RAG, tool-calling, evaluation and memory. For someone obsessed with how agents actually work under the hood.
🛠️ 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝘅𝟮 - Hands-on technical leadership across the core product; set the bar, unblock the team, stay in the code.
🏗️ 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱 - Own architecture, performance, security and scale (backend/Python) as the escalation point for hard technical calls while still shipping.
🤝 𝗦𝗼𝗹𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿 - The technical authority in the enterprise sales cycle: discovery, custom demos, POCs and security reviews that win deals.
⚖️ 𝗔𝗜 𝗚𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱 - Turn AI regulation (EU AI Act, ISO 42001, GDPR) into concrete technical controls - monitoring, audit trails, human-in-the-loop - and be the responsible-AI point of contact for enterprise clients.
💻 𝗜𝗧 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗿 - Own internal IT end-to-end: infrastructure, cloud, incident response, vendor management and the security/ISO 27001 posture enterprise customers scrutinise.
🌐 𝗙𝗼𝗿𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗱 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗹𝗼𝘆𝗲𝗱 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝘀 — French / German / Italian speakers — Embed with enterprise clients, build the integrations, and own getting them live and successful. Native-market language = huge advantage.
🧭 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗹𝗼𝘆𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗶𝘀𝘁 - Lead customer rollout, adoption and value realisation, bridging product, engineering and the client.

Fluent English is essential across all roles; Spanish and other European languages are a strong plus.

Know someone brilliant or is it you? DM me or comment and I'll share the full details.

#𝗛𝗶𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 #𝗔𝗜 #𝗔𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗔𝗜 #𝗠𝗮𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 #𝗙𝗼𝗿𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗱𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗹𝗼𝘆𝗲𝗱 #𝗔𝗜𝗚𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 #𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗝𝗼𝗯𝘀 #𝗕𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗻𝗮 #𝗠𝗮𝗱𝗿𝗶𝗱 #𝗡𝗼𝘄𝗛𝗶𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴
What a moment to join such an incredible project!

What a first half. 🚀

We don't usually stop to look back mid-year, but the numbers made it impossible not to.

Since January, Wave has:

📈 Welcomed 110 new clients
 📈 Doubled our Q2 and H1 revenue YoY
 📈 Already generated 80% of all of 2025's revenue in six months
 📈 Grown headcount from 34 to 57 (and we're still hiring)

And then there's Wave Mind, our Slack-native AI recruiter, which launched just last month:

🤖 11 clients already live
 🤖 4 hires made through it already
 🤖 70% of candidates it shortlists get picked for interview (and this is only V1)

Here's one that still makes us do a double-take: some of our consultants are personally out-earning London CEOs, with several on track for £400k in personal billings this year. That's the calibre of talent we get to work alongside every day.

None of this happens without an incredible team and clients who trust us to keep raising the bar. Huge thanks to everyone who's been part of this ride so far.

H2, we're just getting started. 👋
